name: Teachers
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of teachers in guiding and instructing God's people, as seen in Psalms 32:8 where the Lord promises to teach and counsel the way to go. The example of Samuel overseeing the school of prophets (1 Samuel 19:20) and Elisha leading the sons of the prophets at Gilgal (2 Kings 4:38) illustrates the importance of godly leadership in spiritual education. Proverbs 22:6 emphasizes the responsibility to train children in the right way so they remain steadfast in faith. Additionally, Deuteronomy 13:1 warns believers to discern and judge false teachers who may arise with signs and wonders, underscoring the need for vigilance in maintaining doctrinal purity.
